raw_segments.text: King Henry. No, Kate. I will tell the enfrench, which I am sure will hang upon my tongue like a new married wife about her husband's neck, hardly to be shook off.
Je quand sur le possession de France, et quand vous avez le possession de moi. Let me see what then.
St. Denny's be my speed. Donc vaudarest France, et vous erts mien. It is as easy for me, Kate, to conquer the kingdom as to speak so much more French.
I shall never move the enfrench unless it be to laugh at me.
